notes:
A new engine and a completely rebuilt interface.

## New engine
- SteamLite now runs on Tauri 2 (Rust and the system web view) instead of Electron. The installer is about 25 MB instead of about 103 MB, and the app itself is a few megabytes.
- Everything behind the interface (your library, settings, Steam and Discord connections, play tracking, hotkeys, tray, updates) is the same proven backend as before. Your settings and data carry over unchanged.

## New interface
- Rebuilt from scratch with GPU-friendly animation: springs on every press and hover, pages that scroll up and down as you move between them, a floating dock, and a soft glow that takes the colour of the game you are looking at.
- Home, Library (smooth even with thousands of games, grid or list, collections, A to Z jump), game pages (stats, achievements, news, screenshots, notes, launch options), Friends, Profile, Themes, Settings and a search you can open anywhere with Ctrl+K.
- The Play button shows Loading..., Stop and Stopping... while the game starts and closes.
- Profile customisation: banner, tagline, title, avatar frame, accent colour, game showcase and pinned achievements.
- All existing themes work.
- A short introduction opens after you first sign in, and can be replayed from Settings.

## Messages
- Chat with your SteamLite friends: reply, react, edit and delete your messages, pin, and mute a chat. Photos and GIFs show in the chat and open full size. Chats sync with SteamLite Messages on your phone.
- Notifications for new messages and friend requests: a pop-up, a sound, a Windows notification, a note in your history and a badge on the Messages button. Streaks that end tonight are announced too. Turn them off in Settings > Sound & alerts.
- Block someone from a chat, and unblock them from the chat or from the Blocked players list.

## News and updates
- A News page (SteamLite news, news from your games, your notification history) you can open from anywhere. Update notices appear on any page.
- Works with the SteamLite Updater: the release installer is named SteamLite.Setup.<version>.exe, installs over an existing SteamLite in the same folder (replacing the old program files, keeping your settings) and understands the updater's /S, /AllUsers and /CurrentUser switches.
- While the SteamLite Online server is switched off for maintenance, a small notice appears at the bottom of the window.

## Not in 10.0.0 yet
- Drops, the shop, the trophy room, events, wishlist and sales, inventory and the tools hub from 9.x are not in this version. They will return in the new design.
